headlineForKbBuilder.jobLogIsEMPTY_atAF: Observed. American Freight's Job Log contains **0 entries** (grid totalCount=0), against BBW's 818. No import, export or scheduled job has ever run at this tenant. **AF therefore cannot supply the failure vocabulary or the retry control you asked for - BBW is the only place to get them.** Please don't treat AF silence as evidence that failure states don't exist.

jobLog.url: /en/admin/JobLogEdit.jsp?type=joblog (Report Log is the same JSP with type=reportlog)
jobLog.errorReportSurface: Observed, from the column definitions even with no rows: the grid carries **`Input File` (InputDataFileName)** and **`Log File` (LogFileName)** columns. So each job run records both the file it consumed and a log file - that IS the error-report surface. Whether the log is downloadable, and what a failed row looks like, cannot be determined from AF because there are no rows.
jobLog.retryControl: NOT OBSERVABLE at AF - the Actions column (EditDeleteLink) exists but renders nothing without rows.

exportConfiguration.title: Export Data
exportConfiguration.whatItExports: Observed. The grid columns are **Page Layout Name / Primary Table / Top Menu / Previous Layout** - so `Export Configuration` exports **PAGE LAYOUTS**, not drop-downs and not data fields. That answers the question directly: it is a layout-migration tool.
exportConfiguration.notableControl: A checkbox **`isCopyWithinSameEnvironment`** - the export distinguishes copying within one environment from moving between environments, which implies id remapping on cross-environment import. That is consistent with the re-keyed PageLayoutID blocks seen between AF and BBW (+2626..+2677).
exportConfiguration.download: NOT triggered. I recorded what the screen offers and downloaded nothing.

importData.title: Import Data
importData.staticHtmlFindings: The page is an ExtJS shell - the static HTML exposes no file input and no column-mapping controls, so the workflow (object -> file -> mapping -> dry-run -> error report) cannot be read from the markup alone.
importData.upsertKeyQuestion: NOT answerable from AF's UI. Zero `ClientID`/`BOMapClientRecordID` mentions in the rendered page, and with an empty Job Log there is no executed import to inspect. **The REST evidence already settles this** (`@clientID` IS `BOMapClientRecordID`; `/clientid/{id}` addresses records; `POST ...?allowUpdate=true` upserts) - the UI neither confirms nor contradicts it.
